threats: uncooperative privileged writer with directory write access
replacement via alternate mount or namespace path
record substitution between canonical read and unlink
cgroup name substitution between fd custody check and rmdir
crash after mutation before directory fsync
confirmed_existing_controls: pinned descriptors and directory ancestry checks
root-owned restrictive directories and regular files
canonical intent and recorded inode comparisons
fail-closed quarantine on missing durable sweep intent
unproven_assumptions: no privileged uncooperative writer can mutate parent
no writable alternate mount of same underlying directory
journal content and directory entry stable through unlink
filesystem persistence guarantees for interrupted birth and cleanup
required_followup: Independent threat-model approval, privilege and mount-writer enumeration, controlled adversarial race/crash tests, then design-reviewed remediation.
